entries.title: Numbers 2:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:

entries.title: Numbers 2:2
segments: "Everyone of the children of Israel shall camp by his own standard, beside the emblems of his father's house; they shall camp some distance from the tabernacle of meeting.

entries.title: Numbers 2:3
segments: ¶"On the east side, toward the rising of the sun, those of the standard of the forces with Judah shall camp according to their armies; and Nahshon the son of Amminadab [shall be] the leader of the children of Judah."

entries.title: Numbers 2:4
segments: And his army was numbered at seventy-four thousand six hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:5
segments: "Those who camp next to him [shall be] the tribe of Issachar, and Nethanel the son of Zuar [shall be] the leader of the children of Issachar."

entries.title: Numbers 2:6
segments: And his army was numbered at fifty-four thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:7
segments: "Then [comes] the tribe of Zebulun, and Eliab the son of Helon [shall be] the leader of the children of Zebulun."

entries.title: Numbers 2:8
segments: And his army was numbered at fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:9
segments: "All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Judah, one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred-these shall break camp first.

entries.title: Numbers 2:10
segments: "On the south side [shall be] the standard of the forces with Reuben according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Reuben [shall be] Elizur the son of Shedeur."

entries.title: Numbers 2:11
segments: And his army was numbered at forty-six thousand five hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:12
segments: "Those who camp next to him [shall be] the tribe of Simeon, and the leader of the children of Simeon [shall be] Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai."

entries.title: Numbers 2:13
segments: And his army was numbered at fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:14
segments: "Then [comes] the tribe of Gad, and the leader of the children of Gad [shall be] Eliasaph the son of Reuel."

entries.title: Numbers 2:15
segments: And his army was numbered at forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.

entries.title: Numbers 2:16
segments: "All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Reuben, one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty-they shall be the second to break camp.

entries.title: Numbers 2:17
segments: "And the tabernacle of meeting shall move out with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps; as they camp, so they shall move out, everyone in his place, by their standards.

entries.title: Numbers 2:18
segments: "On the west side [shall be] the standard of the forces with Ephraim according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Ephraim [shall be] Elishama the son of Ammihud."

entries.title: Numbers 2:19
segments: And his army was numbered at forty thousand five hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:20
segments: "Next to him [comes] the tribe of Manasseh, and the leader of the children of Manasseh [shall be] Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur."

entries.title: Numbers 2:21
segments: And his army was numbered at thirty-two thousand two hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:22
segments: "Then [comes] the tribe of Benjamin, and the leader of the children of Benjamin [shall be] Abidan the son of Gideoni."

entries.title: Numbers 2:23
segments: And his army was numbered at thirty-five thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:24
segments: "All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Ephraim, one hundred and eight thousand one hundred-they shall be the third to break camp.

entries.title: Numbers 2:25
segments: "The standard of the forces with Dan [shall be] on the north side according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Dan [shall be] Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai."

entries.title: Numbers 2:26
segments: And his army was numbered at sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:27
segments: "Those who camp next to him [shall be] the tribe of Asher, and the leader of the children of Asher [shall be] Pagiel the son of Ocran."

entries.title: Numbers 2:28
segments: And his army was numbered at forty-one thousand five hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:29
segments: "Then [comes] the tribe of Naphtali, and the leader of the children of Naphtali [shall be] Ahira the son of Enan."

entries.title: Numbers 2:30
segments: And his army was numbered at fifty-three thousand four hundred.

entries.title: Numbers 2:31
segments: "All who were numbered of the forces with Dan, one hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred-they shall break camp last, with their standards."

entries.title: Numbers 2:32
segments: These [are] the ones who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses. All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces [were] six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

entries.title: Numbers 2:33
segments: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, just as the LORD commanded Moses.

entries.title: Numbers 2:34
segments: Thus the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they camped by their standards and so they broke camp, each one by his family, according to their fathers' houses.
